  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/ots/src/silf.cc","function":"OpenTypeSILF::SILSub::ParsePart","line":277,"var":"this->oPasses[i]","code":"for (unsigned i = 0; i <= this->numPasses; ++i) { this->oPasses.emplace_back(); if (!table.ReadU32(&this->oPasses[i]) || this->oPasses[i] < last_oPass) { return false; } }","note":"The parser records pass offsets from the input, including the final sentinel offset used to bound later reads."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/ots/src/silf.cc","function":"OpenTypeSILF::SILSub::ParsePart","line":328,"var":"this->passes[i]","code":"for (unsigned i = 0; i < this->numPasses; ++i) { this->passes.emplace_back(parent); if (!this->passes[i].ParsePart(table, init_offset, this->oPasses[i+1])) { return parent->Error(...); } }","note":"Each pass is parsed using the attacker-supplied next-pass offset as an upper bound for internal sections."},

  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/ots/src/silf.cc","function":"OpenTypeSILF::SILSub::SILPass::ParsePart","line":722,"var":"ruleMap_len","code":"if (oRuleMap[i] > ruleMap_len) { ruleMap_len = oRuleMap[i]; }","note":"The maximum rule-map offset is derived from the just-read offsets and controls the next allocation/read loop."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/ots/src/silf.cc","function":"OpenTypeSILF::SILSub::SILPass::ParsePart","line":728,"var":"this->ruleMap[i]","code":"for (unsigned i = 0; i < ruleMap_len; ++i) { this->ruleMap.emplace_back(); if (!table.ReadU16(&this->ruleMap[i])) { return parent->Error(...); } }","note":"The parser performs another attacker-sized read loop based on the computed length, and the crash is triggered later when Buffer::ReadU16 consumes uninitialized bytes from the malformed SILF layout."}
